title: CT scan of the implant arranged by an unnamed insider

tellings.quote: Anyway, he wants me to get a CT scan of the implant.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber says an insider, whom he does not name, wanted him to get a CT scan, a detailed X-ray image of the inside of the body, of an implant: a small object he believes was placed in his body. Strieber tells it as something he took part in himself, in California, and he credits the scan as a record of the object. If true, it would mean someone on the inside took his implant claim seriously enough to want it imaged.
